items.claim: Ravena Oliveira is a Muay Thai striker with offensive takedowns and a 100% finish rate in her wins.
items.quote: She's taking on Ravena Oliveira, a Muay Thai striker who has some offensive takedowns... she has a 100% finish rate in her wins

items.claim: Ravena Oliveira is coming off a knockout loss to Chanel Dyer.
items.quote: She is coming off that knockout loss to Chanel Dyer

items.claim: Juliana Miller relies on toughness and grit rather than actual skills.
items.quote: She relies on the toughness, relies on the grit... but she has no actual skills.

items.claim: Steven Asplund dropped from 500 lbs to 260 lbs naturally without surgery.
items.quote: he went from 500 lbs to 260 lbs, and he did it the old-fashioned way. No shot, no surgery, just hard work.

items.claim: Steven Asplund has great cardio, pressure, and good power for a big guy.
items.quote: for a big guy, he's got great cardio, he's got great pressure, and he's got good power.

items.claim: Steven Asplund is coming off a decision loss to Vitor Petrino where he dropped Vitor three times but struggled with takedown defense and faded.
items.quote: He is coming off the decision loss though to Vitor Petrino, where he dropped Vitor three times, but he couldn't defend the takedowns, and he did seem to fade a little bit.

items.claim: Guierme Pat uses a wild karate stance and has impressive ability to bounce in and out, but poor takedown defense.
items.quote: He's got that wild karate stance... Takedown defense, however, not impressive.

items.claim: Guierme Pat is coming off a decision loss to Thomas Peterson where hesitancy lost him the fight.
items.quote: He is coming off the decision loss to Thomas Peterson, where the hesitancy is what lost him that fight.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos is a Muay Thai striker who fights at range to avoid takedowns.
items.quote: Amanda Lemos, a Muay Thai striker for the most part, does a good job fighting at that Muay Thai range. And she does that because she wants to avoid takedowns at all cost.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos is coming off a loss to Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: And most recently, she just lost to Gillian Robertson

items.claim: Alexa Tonara is a forward pressure striker whose chin stays up in the air.
items.quote: Alexa Tonara, a forward pressure striker who literally marches forward. Her chin stays up in the air
